title: Product Engineering
description: I build and evolve software products from idea to production, with the engineering needed to support real users.
goodFitIf: You have an idea, or an early product, and need someone to build it properly and see it through to real users.

title: AI Engineering
description: I turn AI capabilities into reliable software that can actually be used in production.
goodFitIf: You want AI to do real work in your business, like answering customers, reading documents or finding leads.

title: AI Prototype To Production
description: Bring your AI prototypes to your customers and make it production-grade and ready to survive real users.
goodFitIf: You have an AI demo that works on your laptop and now it needs to hold up with real customers.

title: Technical Rescue
description: Diagnose and fix software that has become unreliable, difficult to maintain, or expensive to change.
goodFitIf: Your software keeps breaking, is slow, or every change takes far longer than it should.

title: Consultancy & Audit
description: Get an experienced technical perspective on your product, architecture, or engineering decisions before they become expensive problems.
goodFitIf: You're about to make a big technical decision and want an experienced second opinion first.

title: Automation & Integrations
description: Automate repetitive processes and connect systems that currently don't talk to each other.
goodFitIf: Your team copies data between tools by hand, or your systems don't talk to each other.

title: mentorship
description: I offer mentorship for developers looking to strengthen their skills through structured guidance and real-world projects.
goodFitIf: You're a developer who wants structured guidance, project help or career coaching.
